details.text: Details: Attend and check in at an onsite IFS event.
Season Points: Each verified attendant earns their Faction 0.1 Season Point. The total Season Point earned per Faction is capped at 750.

items.text: An individual Agent’s Faction is determined at the time the IFS medal is awarded.
Each Agent will only be credited once per month, regardless of how many IFS events they attended that month.

details.text: Cygnus Tokens: Verified Agents will receive 2,500 Cygnus Tokens, alongside their IFS medal tick, by the end of the month.
